g.text: Held-out pairs: new angles, frequencies and separations
Structured: 72 cases per level, separations 3/6/9/15°, two orientations, three seeds and three spectral relationships. Held-out: 64 cases per level, random 4–18° separations.
One-to-one peak matching within min(3.01°, 45% of source separation). No source-count detector or general resolution guarantee. Weak −12 dB sources remain difficult.
